```sql
SELECT 
    p.fecha,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(p.aprobado) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS tasa_aprobacion
FROM pagos p
WHERE p.medio = 'tarjeta'
  AND p.fecha >= '2026-03-01'
  AND p.fecha <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY p.fecha
ORDER BY p.fecha;
```
